sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emily.
I am happy you are here.
Today, we will talk about Vietnam.
Vietnam is a beautiful, green,
and friendly country in Southeast Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Let's begin.
Where is Vietnam?
Vietnam is in Southeast Asia.
It is next to China, Laos, and Cambodia.
To the east, it touches the South China Sea.
Vietnam is long and thin, like the letter S.
What is the capital city of Vietnam?
The capital city is Hanoi.
Hanoi is in the north.
It has lakes, temples, and old buildings.
Another big city is Ho Chi Minh City.
It was called Saigon before.
It is in the south and is full of energy,
shops, and motorbikes.
Other cities include Da Nang, Hugh, and Canto.
How many people live in Vietnam?
It is one of the most populated countries in Asia.
People live in cities, villages, and countryside.
Vietnam has many ethnic groups and cultures.
What language do people speak in Vietnam?
People speak Vietnamese.
It is the official language.
Vietnamese uses the Latin alphabet, like English,
but with tones and marks.
Some people also speak English, Chinese, or French,
especially in cities and schools.
What is the weather like in Vietnam?
Vietnam has a tropical and warm climate.
In the north, there are four seasons.
In the south, it is hot all year
with a dry season and a rainy season.
It rains a lot from May to October,
especially in the south.
What does Vietnam look like?
Vietnam has many natural places.
Mountains in the north, green rice fields,
rivers like the Mekong and Red River beaches and islands,
caves, waterfalls, and forests.
How long bay is a very famous and beautiful place in Vietnam?
What animals live in Vietnam?
You can find water buffalo, the national animal,
monkeys, bears, and deer,
turtles, snakes, and frogs,
colorful birds, insects, and fish.
People also raise ducks, chickens, pigs, and cows.
What do people eat in Vietnam?
Vietnamese food is fresh, light, and full of flavor.
People eat rice, noodles, and vegetables,
fish, pork, chicken, and herbs.
Popular dishes?
Faux, noodle soup with beef or chicken.
Bond me a sandwich in French-style bread.
Spring rolls fresh or fried with vegetables and meat.
Buncha, grilled pork with noodles.
Com Tom, broken rice with meat and egg.
People also eat fruit like mango,
dragon fruit, and banana.
What do people drink in Vietnam?
People drink tea, green tea or lotus tea.
Coffee, strong Vietnamese coffee with sweet milk,
juices like sugar cane or coconut juice,
soy milk and herbal drinks.
Ice drinks are popular because the weather is hot.
What is life like in Vietnam?
Life in Vietnam is busy, lively, and friendly.
People go to school, work, and markets every day.
Many people ride motorbikes.
Family is very important and people often live together.
People enjoy eating out at street stalls,
visiting temples, watching TV or chatting with friends,
drinking tea and relaxing at cafes.
What are some holidays and traditions in Vietnam?
Tate, Lunar New Year, the biggest holiday in Vietnam,
Mid-Autumn Festival with lanterns and mooncakes.
National Day, September 2nd,
Hung Kings Day to honor Vietnam's ancient kings,
Buddha's birthday.
During Tate, people clean their homes,
give red envelopes, and eat special food.
Families get together and visit relatives.
Some fun facts about Vietnam.
The Vietnamese flag is red with a yellow star.
Vietnam is one of the world's top coffee producers.
Most people use chopsticks to eat.
Vietnam has over 3,000 kilometers of coastline.
The word fo is said like pho.
Now you know many things about Vietnam.
You know where it is, what people speak,
and what they eat.
You learned about the food, culture, cities, and daily life.
Great job!
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Vietnamese,
Tom Bitt.
